0022600115.text: Toronto, 2-0 and second in the Atlantic, visits Minnesota, also 2-0 and third in the Northwest, in the Raptors' third game of the season. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Raptors lost their last meeting 115-107 in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which Toronto lost 0-2.
